messages:
mohan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can leads post brief, actionable dates for Optimize (suggestions) + Console onramp so GTM has something to share?

elaine: Short answers: Hosted GA mid-May 2025; Dedicated preview early May, GA in June; Private by request starting June with rollouts through July. Will add checklist.

riley: We'll ship a Console canary template. Suggested defaults: percent=5, selector org_tier="beta" and path_regex="^/v1/generate".

sam: Perf impact numbers to cite?

elaine: Benchmarks: median +7-12ms per token at seq=512; p95 +20-40ms under medium load; cost ~+3% compute. Perf deck + scripts next week.

anna: Migration: auto-upgrade routes?

riley: No. One-click migrate route in Console + CLI script in devex. Manual opt-in only.

mohan: Please post owners/dates.

elaine: Owners/dates: elaine - publish timeline+checklist by 2025-05-05; riley - Console template by 2025-04-28; sam - publish benchmarks by 2025-05-02.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed: console-template v3.2 -> 5% traffic (id: canary-179123).

mohan: Thanks all, will surface these on the roadmap board.
